notes: Fully rebuilt 2026-07-24 as a brand-new file (no pre-existing business_10 file existed). Every channel is now a real, named entity -- no UNCONFIRMED placeholders remain. 'Poultry Farming Africa', 'Agric TV Nigeria', and 'Nigerian Farmer' were generic/descriptive labels that did not resolve to real channels and were replaced with Techpoint Africa and The Poultry Site TV. 'Farmcrowdy' (real company, no channel found) was replaced with TechCabal, which covers Farmcrowdy's business model directly. 'Backyard Poultry' and 'Vetline Africa' were replaced with Fresh Eggs Daily and Poultry Farm Insider, both confirmed active via an independent poultry-YouTuber directory. Obasanjo Farms' own official website (obasanjofarmsng.com) is used in place of a specific YouTube video since their real documentary content is third-party-produced rather than hosted on one official channel. 2026-08-23: Removed disallowed generic or unauthorized-looking ebook hosts and duplicate book records during repository-wide compliance cleanup. 2026-08-23: Added 60 selected Project Gutenberg public-domain non-fiction records to the General collection.
